content:
morgan: Heads-up — Acme banking POC just asked for a single zipped evidence bundle for procurement: SOC 2 Type II report, ISO 27001 certificate, and a pen-test confirmation letter. They want it attached to the SOW by EOD Fri. Can we assemble what’s shareable?
anya: I can pull the standard SOC2 PDF and ISO cert. Do we have an up-to-date pen-test letter template? The last signed pen-test letter was for PartnerCo in Oct.2024.
raj: We have a pen-test attestation template that legal signs. Full pen-test reports require an NDA in most cases; we usually redact IP and specific hostnames.
eva: Correct — legal requires a signed NDA for full pentest reports. We can provide a signed pen-test confirmation letter (one-page) that summarizes scope and date without vuln details. I can sign if it’s the standard template.
morgan: Customer asked explicitly for the "pen-test letter" (not the full report). Procurement might accept that + SOC2/ISO. Can we confirm names/dates to include?
anya: SOC2: file is /shared/assurance/soc2/redwood-soc2-typeii-2024-09.pdf
anya: ISO: /shared/assurance/iso27001/redwood-iso27001-cert-2023.pdf
anya: Pen-test letter template: /shared/assurance/pen-test/pen-test-letter-template.docx
raj: For the pen-test letter we should include: scope (infrastructure + hosted API), vendor (Redwood Inference), date of test (2024-10-15), and statement that full report is available under NDA.
eva: Also add an asset boundary sentence: "This letter covers Redwood Inference hosted production systems. It does not cover customer-managed private deployments."
morgan: Can someone draft and attach? I need it by tomorrow morning to review before sending.
anya: I’ll draft and attach a PDF here by 09:00 PT tomorrow.
raj: FYI: For AcmeBank we should also include a short note about our pen-test cadence (annual + major release). I’ll add a one-liner.
eva: I’ll prepare an NDA blurb in case procurement pushes for the full report. Also confirm we’ll not include any raw vuln output.
morgan: Perfect. Also pricing/legal asked if providing these docs triggers any extra approval — e.g., for Dedicated customers we sometimes need infra team sign-off. Any blockers?
raj: No infra sign-off needed for the letter itself. If they request network diagrams, that’s escalated.
anya: If they request SOC 2 bridge letters or management response details, that could take longer — flagging now.
anya: Draft is uploaded: /shared/temp/acme-poc/evidence/redwood-acme-penletter-draft-v1.pdf (placeholder)
morgan: Nice. I’ll review at 08:30. If all good I’ll attach to SOW and send to procurement.
devops-bot: deploy log — doc-bundle-generator ran for /shared/temp/acme-poc at 2025-06-20T07:12:05Z; output: redwood-acme-evidence-bundle-v1.zip
anya: Bundle created: redwood-acme-evidence-bundle-v1.zip contains SOC2 pdf, ISO cert, pen-test-letter-draft-v1.pdf, and a readme.txt noting NDA requirement for full reports.
morgan: Sending to AcmeProcurement now. Thanks team :thumbsup:
raj: One more note — mark the pen-test letter as "for procurement only" and set retention to 90 days in the bundle readme.
eva: I’ll drop the NDA template for their legal team if they request it: /shared/legal/ndas/standard-pen-test-nda-v2.pdf
morgan: Excellent. Closing this thread — ping me if Acme requests the full report.
